text:
Alex P.: Heads up — opened a docs PR to clarify model compatibility notes and limits for the new quantized variants: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4982 :eyes:
Maya R.: nice, thanks. Is this also updating the latency/throughput numbers in the catalog page?
Alex P.: yeah, I bumped the per-GPU token/sec and added a note about 8-bit KVs being experimental.
Jordan L.: quick heads-up — the SDK example in the model card still uses the old `client.generate()` signature. I pushed a tiny fix to the PR branch.
Samir K.: thanks — I'll re-run the perf table after the SDK snippet change. FYI my bench run showed a ~8% delta when batch_size=16 vs 8 for the quantized model.
Maya R.: can we add a short migration snippet for teams moving from v1->v2 inference config? folks keep asking.
Jordan L.: sure, propose adding this under "Migration notes":

```
# v1 style
resp = client.generate(model="aether-7b-q8", input=prompt)
\n# v2 style (pin quantized variant explicit)
resp = client.text.generate(model="aether-7b@q8-2025-11-01", input=prompt, max_tokens=512)
```

Jordan L.: also callout that pinning version avoids subtle perf/compat shifts.
docs-bot: linkcheck failed for /model-catalog/aether-7b -> 404 (branch: alex/compat-notes).
Alex P.: @docs-bot thanks — I broke that link when I moved the example file. I'll fix.
ci-bot: docs build failed — missing snippet marker in model-card/aether-7b.md: `SNIPPET_START:sdk-ex-v2` not found.
Maya R.: I can add the marker and a short sentence about limits (max sequence 4096, recommended batch <= 16). Keeping language tight.
Samir K.: for the benchmark numbers in the catalog table, use median p95 latency and list machine/instance (e.g., a100-40GB, fp16/8-bit). I'll attach raw bench csv to the PR.
Alex P.: sounds good. Also let's add a compatibility table row: "quantized variant" + "supported features" (streaming=no, function-calls=partial).
Jordan L.: wording suggestion: "Quantized variants may have limited support for long-context streaming and some function-calling edge cases; pin model version to guarantee behavior."
Maya R.: +1. I'll update the PR description and add a short migration checklist at the top of the card.
Alex P.: great — once CI clears can someone merge? This is blocking a release note for Dedicated customers.
Samir K.: I'll re-run benches after the snippet fix and re-run the linkcheck. Expect green in ~30m. :thumbsup:
Jordan L.: if anyone wants to eyeball the phrasing for the compatibility note ping me, I can do a quick pass.
Maya R.: thanks all — converging. I'll push the marker fix in 10 and rebase.
Alex P.: thanks team, really appreciate the quick turnaround.
ci-bot: build passed on branch alex/compat-notes (job #2244).
docs-bot: deployed preview: https://deploy-preview--docs.redwood.ai/model-catalog/aether-7b
Maya R.: preview looks good, merging after Samir's final bench attach.
Samir K.: attached CSV and final numbers, merging now.
Alex P.: merged — closing thread. :tada:
